messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up — FinTrust legal/compliance signed off on an NDA and they want to kick off a Private deployment POC next week. They specifically want PrivateLink + on‑prem outbound via their corporate proxy. Need: exact firewall/egress allowlist, whether we can provide fixed egress IPs, and rough pricing delta vs Hosted. Looping in @jess_eng and @paul_netops for network + pricing.

jess_eng: Got it. For the POC we usually recommend PrivateLink if they don’t want to change their routing. Alternatives: VPC peering (simpler for intra-VPC traffic) or Transit Gateway if multiple VPCs. PrivateLink gives isolation and avoids route table changes.

paul_netops: Quick checklist of what they must allow from on-prem -> our endpoints:
```
# Customer egress (example)
TCP 443  -> control-plane.api.redwood-inference.com  (TLS)
TCP 8443 -> runtime-models.us-east-1.redwood-inference.internal  (gRPC/tls)
# If using PrivateLink, allow the ENI CIDRs we share per-region
# DNS: enable outbound to resolve our service names
```
They probably want those as FQDNs + our region ENI CIDRs. We will provide exact CIDR list in the handoff doc.

mike_sre: Two clarifications: 1) Do they require our egress to appear from a fixed public IP? 2) Are they doing allowlist on the proxy, or will they NAT through their corporate internet egress?

alex_sales: They said "fixed egress IPs preferred" and their security team will only accept allowlist entries (no domain-only rules). Also asked about pricing impact for Dedicated + static egress.

jess_eng: Pricing notes:
- PrivateLink: one-time setup engineering + per-hour endpoint charge (AWS charges apply); we bill a configuration/setup fee for Private deployments during POC ($1,200 one-time typical for small POCs).
- Static egress IPs / NAT: available on Dedicated instances as an add-on — typically ~$800/mo for reserved mapping + per-GB egress. For a 30-day POC we usually do a flat trial fee instead of monthly.
Ballpark: POC incremental = setup fee + small monthly endpoint + egress estimate. I can run numbers if you share expected TPS and token volumes.

paul_netops: Security blockers to preempt: they want an architecture diagram, data flow, and proof of SOC2 + encryption-at-rest details. If they request a penetration test report or specific questionnaire items, we have a standard security pack (SLA, SOC2, flow diagram, runbook). @alex_sales — add which items they already asked for so we don’t duplicate.

alex_sales: They pasted a short sec-quest: ask #6 about key rotation policy, #11 about logging retention, #17 about egress IP ranges. I’ll drop that into the shared drive. Can you confirm we can provide runbook + SOC2 cert?

jess_eng: Yes — we can provide SOC2 Type II summary and our runbook. For key rotation we use KMS-integrated rotation (customer-managed CMKs available for Private). Logging retention is configurable in Console; standard retention is 90 days for request logs, archive available for longer with a charge.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: POC kickoff meeting created for 2045683200 (calendar invite sent). Assigned: jess_eng (tech lead), paul_netops (network), alex_sales (sales lead).

mike_sre: Action items: 1) jess to produce POC cost estimate (including PrivateLink/setups + egress) — ETA EOD tomorrow. 2) paul to prepare allowlist CIDRs and sample firewall snippet. 3) alex to upload customer questionnaire and confirm expected traffic profiles. Once we have those, we can give FinTrust a fixed SOW for the POC.

alex_sales: Thanks team — I’ll push the questionnaire now and request a decision on whether they want a Dedicated POC with static egress or a PrivateLink-backed Private deployment. Will update here with customer confirmation. :thumbsup:
